Part of being happy is where you point your attention.

Kevin Trudeau explains that focus matters: the past, the present or the future. When you look back, do you dwell on traumas and disasters, or recall the times you did really well?

He calls it one piece of a mathematical equation for happiness, and says balance is the key. From there you can make small adjustments.

When did you last replay a win instead of a mistake?
